name: Ultimate Light Rail
summary: Light rail stations: surface, underground or elevated, with five lengths and covered platforms.
description: Ultimate Light Rail 0.15.0 introduces the first versioned station API. The existing configurable station is now the first consumer, using the standard design through the same validated contract available to future add-ons. All 60 generated configurations and 12 default/legacy cases exactly match the full pre-contract 0.14.2 construction output in automated comparison. Supported layouts remain two platform tracks, five lengths, surface/underground/elevated and through/terminus. Six defined visual asset roles can be replaced while core geometry, terminals and walking paths stay under core control; replacement models must match the reference geometry and collision envelope. No automatic rebuilding, new menu options or changes to saved parameter indices. Independent add-on loading in-game is still to be verified; an optional source example is provided in the repository. Do not remove the mod while its infrastructure remains in a save.
